newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Congestion constrains Bunds up to 101.05.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Congestion constrains Bunds up to 101.05.

text.p: June Bund futures traded on LIFFE will continue to seek direction on Tuesday but will be constrained to the upside by areas of congestion up to 101.05, technical analysts said.
"The market has no inspiration at the moment," said Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking here.

"Potentially we could have a small upside bias to start with." But even above initial congestion at 100.52-55 the market was set to run into another area of congestion around 100.74 and 100.78, he said.
At 0705 GMT, June Bunds were at 100.60, up 0.19
Ostwald said he did not see the contract getting much beyond 100.78 but if it did, the highs from April 16 and 24 at 101.02 and 101.05 would cap trade for this session.
He said to the downside initial support came in at the lows for the previous two sessions at 100.29 and 100.28.
"We are close to 6.0 percent levels on the new 10-year Bund and that seems to be supporting the market," Ostwald said.

Fundamentals were adding to the lacklustre tone in all the debt markets, as players awaited the U.S. non-farm payrolls report on Friday. But with little domestic data for Germany, Bunds were seeking direction, he said.

Technical analysts at a European bank in London said the reverse head and shoulders pattern still looked bullish and would only fail below 99.70. That level was the low on April 14 and the high on April 1.

"Bunds have remained uninspired, but we continue to look for a push to 101.60 in due course," they said in a research note, adding that initial resistance was at 100.74 with a further barrier at 101.12, 101.13.
At the short end, June Euromark futures were unchanged at 96.74. The European bank analysts said there was scope for a push higher to the low 96.80s.
